annotations.title: Tracked GTA 6 markets and price status

description: Use this when someone asks which countries GTA 6 prices are tracked for, or which prices are confirmed. Lists every tracked market (98 today) with the price status of each; prices were last fully rechecked on October 24, 2026. Optional filter by status.

status.description: Only markets with this price status: confirmed (read from the local store), reported (a named outlet reported it), estimate (not yet confirmed), usd (the store bills in US dollars), none (no local store). Leave out for every market.
